### Retrieve a worker concurrency limit

`GET /admin/sidekiq/concurrency_limits/:worker_class` · [docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/admin_sidekiq_queues/#retrieve-a-worker-concurrency-limit)

- Response attributes: `adaptive_limit` (integer or null), `class_limit` (integer or null), `default_limit_requires_shard_context` (boolean), `deferred_jobs` (integer), `disabled_for_worker` (boolean), `effective_limit` (integer or null), `middleware_enabled` (boolean), `override_limit` (integer or null), `override_ttl` (integer or null), `running_jobs` (integer), `worker_class` (string)

| Attribute | In | Type | Required | Default | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `worker_class` | path | string | yes |  |  |  |
